label: FP
reason: The XSS sinks (rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue()) receive data from server-side sources only: getClass().getName() returns a fixed class name, and rememberMe.getValue() contains rememberMeKey which is generated server-side using ESAPI encoder from SecureRandom.randomBytes(). The user-provided 'param' parameter does not flow to any output sink. All data reaching the HTML output is controlled by the application.

evidence.note: XSS sinks receiving server-generated data only
